$comment: Single source of truth for Nexus Core DevOps gates (scripts/devops, scripts/org-init, CI). activeModules deploy to the headless scratch org (CI); <profile>ProfileModules add modules that need another org shape (setup-scratch-headless.sh --profile full|agentforce: full = OmniStudio, Experience Cloud, CRM Analytics, React on DevHubGS; agentforce = HXL widgets, Agentforce, MCP on an Agentforce-entitled Dev Hub) and are covered by the static gates in every case.

deployStages.$comment: Full-profile modules deploy in these stages (directory names, or paths relative to the module), then whole. OmniStudio validates references at deploy time; a site's guest profile and guest sharing rules exist only once the site does.

deployApiVersions.$comment: Modules whose metadata needs a newer API than sfdx-project.json sourceApiVersion (UIBundle, WaveTemplateBundle with recipe R3 assets: 66.0+; UiWidgetBundle, LightningTypeBundle, McpServerDefinition (HXL beta): 67.0+). They deploy from a manifest generated at this version; drift retrieves at the highest version in use.
